environment: local colima Docker context; no VPS operations
measurement_note: Container/volume/database allocated bytes are exact pre-removal du values on exclusive paths verified absent afterward; image confirmed bytes count vanished content-store blobs only. Per-operation VM free deltas include asynchronous Docker snapshot GC/background writes and are observations, not independently attributable object sizes. Whole-window VM/host net changes and these object counters must not be added. Host free space decreased; no host reclaimed-space or VM-disk-compaction claim. Networks have no separately attributed bytes.

cl01-stack.method: Use the complete fixed checkout and retained cl01-isolated/server/web image references to recreate a new isolated Compose project. Keep original bind fixtures at registered paths; restore the archived dump when exact synthetic failure/task state is required. Never attach this lab to an existing business/evaluation database.

schema17.method: Create a new private pgvector/pgvector:pg17 cluster; empty real key and network none/shared isolated namespace; alembic upgrade 000017. Verified 29 user tables and all empty-table hashes.

schema21.method: Create a new private pgvector/pgvector:pg17 cluster or a fresh named database; empty real key and isolated network; alembic upgrade 000021. Verified 39 user tables and all empty-table hashes.

archived-dump.method: Read the named member from retained-evidence.tar.gz, verify evidence/manifest.json, then pg_restore --exit-on-error --no-owner --no-privileges into a new isolated empty database. Six current synthetic snapshots match every user-table count/hash; three original backup dumps also restored. New container/database IDs are expected.

cl04-test-image.method: Build server/tests/Dockerfile from the corresponding full checkout and locked dependencies. Mount that source read-only; use only a newly created isolated database. No original output is stored in these dependency images.

cl04-runtime-image.method: Rebuild deploy/server.Dockerfile from the fixed checkout. The first runtime and final sentinel have identical rootfs layer lists to retained runtime-final. The first polluted sentinel is a disposable negative-control build; its original inventory/failure record and synthetic context remain in ~/.cache/unspun/cl-04b-image-20261029/.

empty-volume.method: Create a new volume with the recorded owner and mount destination; no user files existed. Anonymous names and container IDs need not be reused.

network.method: Recreate an exclusive lab network with the recorded internal setting or the fixed scenario Compose files. Do not join existing preview/source networks.

cl04-stack.method: Create a fresh exclusive internal network, a new pgvector/pgvector:pg17 container/volume and the recorded database name. Apply schema21 or restore the recorded smoke dump. API containers use retained unspun-cl04b:runtime-final-20261029, empty real key and the new database network namespace, with no published port. The retained ~/.cache/unspun/cl-04b-image-20261029/smoke_image.py records the original validation commands; never point it at an existing preview/evaluation database. Test dependencies can be rebuilt through cl04-test-image.

checks_by_kind.container: Checked exact owner/image/mounts, writable-layer leaf paths, process references and shared network namespaces. No external dependency. Five running lab databases had zero client sessions, stopped cleanly with exit 0, then removed without force. Docker logs are archived as evidence/container-logs/<name>.log except the never-started inert worker; RSSHub combined logs are also archived. Status alone was not a deletion criterion.
checks_by_kind.volume: Checked all container references, owner registration and actual contents; zero references immediately before explicit volume rm. Nineteen clusters were audited with SELECT/read-only transactions; stopped originals were mounted read-only into network-none RAM clones. Paid/accounting tables are empty; nonempty synthetic states and original backup dumps were archived and restored before removal.
checks_by_kind.database: CL-04A registration matched. Only schema version row, zero business/accounting rows and zero sessions. dropdb without force; all other shared-cluster databases remain.
checks_by_kind.network: Exclusive lab network, exact ID/name/internal setting checked; zero remaining endpoints.
checks_by_kind.image: Completed-validation intermediates only, exact tag/ID checked. Current final/baseline, historical recovery images and R2-04 references preserved. Blob counts exclude shared/cache contents; image virtual sizes are not reclaimed bytes.
